title: Chapter 9 Intermediate Warehouse
content:
Chapter 9 Intermediate Warehouse

After sorting it out in the morning, Wang Shuo had a smile on his face.

Flax × 1200; fish × 50; flaxseed × 400, clay, water, and some loach and eels.

Wang Shuo was greatly relieved and quickly grilled two fish to reward himself.

He also took advantage of his free time to make all the flax into hemp rope, since he didn't need to do it himself. Then the [Chat Channel] was opened.

"I have become a glorious lumberjack. Please call me 'Lumberski'. If you need wood, please send me a private message to exchange it! The quantity is large and the supply is sufficient."

"I was born by the sea, and I will soon become a fisherman! Haha..."

"Please call me 'Mineral Engineer'. Stones can be exchanged for various materials..."

"Upstairs, he changed his job and became a 'miner', right? Hahaha, he is also an engineer..."

"I want to tell you some important news. Beasts in the territory can be killed!"

"Tch..., to put it bluntly, there is a family of little lions outside my territory. I stood on the hill and glanced at the lion father from a distance. I almost peed in fear. Fortunately, he didn't come to chase me at that time."

"One tiger, I'm desperate."

"A fox, will it come to suck my essence at night? I'm so scared."

"I have enough energy. If it can turn into a vixen, let her come to me!"

…

After a night, everyone basically figured out who the companion beasts were in their own territory, or it could be said that whose territory we had invaded.

But Wang Shuo was not sure whether the beasts they encountered were at the elite level, so he asked: "Are there any elite level beasts in your territory?"

"Elite? What kind of elite? I've never heard of it."

"No, there is no special reminder that they are elites."

"Is your beast an elite? Congratulations, we will cheer you on!"

…

"I wonder, am I the only one who is an elite monster, and I don't know how many there are? Special care, the system you..."

Wang Shuo wanted to swear, but he wisely held back.

Seeing that someone wanted to exchange wood and stone for supplies, Wang Shuo negotiated and exchanged loach and eel for 100 units of wood and 100 units of stone, which made the two players feel heartache.

Wang Shuo insisted that they were profiteers.

After all, it is not difficult for Wang Shuo to obtain high-end goods such as clay and adobe bricks.

Given their respective professions, it shouldn't be difficult to obtain these basic supplies.

ID: 3322 Bai Yiming is the player who exchanged wood with Wang Shuo.

His territory was located in a forest. By chance, he quickly obtained an exquisite iron ax, which was extremely effective in cutting down trees.

As the saying goes, a new trick can be eaten all over the world. He is living a very comfortable life now.

Obviously, he was just pretending to complain to Wang Shuo.

Another player's territory is located on a barren mountain. It is bare except for rocks.

But he only had a rusty iron pickaxe, so his collection efficiency was pitifully low and it consumed a lot of energy.

Most resources such as food, water, and wood need to be exchanged.

At this moment, he was really complaining, cursing Wang Shuo as a profiteer in his heart.

Situations like this are a true portrayal of the majority of players. Without a little adventure, survival is really very difficult.

With wood and stone in hand, Wang Shuo opened the [Synthesis Formula].

The system only comes with some very basic item synthesis formulas, mostly based on stone and wood. For slightly more advanced and complex items, players need to explore on their own or obtain production drawings.

[Warehouse: 100/10 wood, 100/10 stone]

[Build or not? 】

"yes."

[Wood-10, Stone-10]

[Construction time 1 minute]

Seeing that there were very few materials required, Wang Shuo was a little pleased.

One minute later, the warehouse was built.

[Warehouse: Provides 100 storage grids, which can be upgraded. 】

Wang Shuo immediately chose to upgrade.

[Intermediate warehouse: wood 90/50, stone 90/50]

[Wood-50, Stone-50]

[Construction time 10 minutes]

After the upgrade is successful, the [Intermediate Warehouse] can provide 500 storage grids, which Wang Shuo feels is enough for the time being.

The items were sorted and sorted, clay, fish and other items were placed in the warehouse, and high-end fishing nets, sophisticated stone axes and other tools were put into the backpack that was carried with them.

After eating the grilled fish, it was already 1 pm, and there was still no exploration of the east and south sides.

He planned to go shopping first and then return to the shelter to make adobe bricks and tiles to upgrade the houses.

Without any further hesitation, he immediately headed south.

When they came to the edge of the swamp, they saw a patch of withered yellow weeds. In the grass, a treasure box with a metallic luster caught all Wang Shuo's eyes. Wang Shuo breathed quickly. At this time, the system prompt sounded:

[I found a bronze treasure chest, do you want to pick it up? 】

Before Wang Shuo could make any move, another system prompt sounded:

【Danger! Discover elite crocodiles. 】

Wang Shuo immediately felt as if a basin of cold water had been poured on him. He was so frightened that he didn't dare to move.

I experienced the feeling of going from heaven to hell.

He observed vigilantly for a while, but found nothing unusual.

"Do you dare to gamble?" Wang Shuo kept beating in his heart.

After a battle between heaven and man, he gave up.

He believed that the crocodile must be hiding in the weeds, maybe sleeping, or maybe too full to move. If he dared to step into the swamp and collect the treasure chest, it would definitely attack him.

"People die for money, birds die for food."

His greed would kill him, and he never dared to forget the "kind reminder" of the "diary".

He immediately backed away slowly.

Fortunately, the crocodile did not find him, and he was somewhat relieved!

After backing away for a distance, Wang Shuo sighed and patted his chest, feeling like he had survived a disaster.

"There is a long way to go, let's wait and see!" Wang Shuo said a harsh word.

He couldn't go south anymore.

He turned to explore the east, which was exactly where the treasure chest was found yesterday. At this moment, there was already a small ditch in the swamp, and there were actually a few water birds playing in the water.

No wonder no fish were found in this direction yesterday.

As soon as he arrived, the water birds all flew away, and Wang Shuo no longer had the desire to continue exploring.

In fact, what he didn't know was that there was also a monster farther in this direction, and he had already walked around the gates of hell.

Back to the shelter.

He immediately started making bricks and tiles.

[Bricks +2]

[Tiles +10]

...

Suddenly, the system prompt sounded:

[Since you have the profession of a bricklayer and "Mastery of Pottery", your luck has exploded. You have made 2 bricks with one material. ]

"Critical hit?" Wang Shuo couldn't help but give a thumbs up to the system. This is possible.

The professional identity of a bricklayer doubled his pottery production speed, and "Mastery of Pottery" reduced his production time by half. The combination of the two has made the production speed soar.

Add "Critical hit", it's really cool.

There were suddenly more bricks and tiles, and he thought about whether other players needed tiles to upgrade their wooden houses? This is a huge business opportunity.

Because his shelter upgrade has already embarked on a path of mutation, he didn't know what materials others needed to upgrade, so he immediately asked in the chat group.

Wang Shuo: "Everyone, do you need tiles to upgrade the wooden house?"

This sentence does not reveal his current upgrade route. Wang Shuo just subconsciously does not want other players to know that his upgrade route has deviated from the normal track.

"I haven't upgraded the wooden house yet, are you all going to upgrade the stone house?"

"Upstairs, I remind you, then you have to hurry up, upgrading the stone house requires 100 tiles."

"What? Who of you has tiles? I want to exchange some."

Sure enough, there is still a big market for high-end materials such as tiles.

"If you need tiles, private message me."

Soon, Wang Shuo's [Private Chat Channel] kept flashing, and players who wanted to privately chat with him lined up in a long line.
